submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 4mm plate thickness delivers the best energy resolution of 3.108% at 100 GeV across all tested configurations. This represents a 25.4% improvement over F3 (3.899%) and 62.4% improvement over F1 (5.047%) at their respective optimal thicknesses. The systematic thickness scan (2-10mm) revealed a clear optimum at 4mm for F2, where the dense alloy with short radiation length provides optimal sampling of electromagnetic showers. F2 is an approved candidate material with no documented exclusions for hands-on maintenance, and is fully compatible with all detector subsystems (mechanical support, cooling, readout). The 4mm thickness balances sampling frequency against energy deposition fluctuations, avoiding the poor performance of thin plates (3.569% at 2mm) and the degradation of thick plates (4.578% at 10mm).
